text: Skill Invocation Monitor 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的只读技能调用监控插件。它在宿主侧观察模型调用 skill 工具及用户触发技能的会话事件，并在网页侧栏加入监控入口和实时面板。面板按 Agent 展示技能名称、调用来源、运行、完成或失败状态、错误摘要、起始时间和经过时长；侧栏徽标显示正在运行的调用数，持续刷新的时长帮助快速发现尚未结束的调用。插件还提供调用状态汇总与观测诊断信息，便于了解事件是否被记录。状态保存在宿主进程内存中，浏览器面板通过本机只读状态接口获取；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

Skill Invocation Monitor tracks DSH skill calls in a read-only web sidebar. It observes model calls and user-triggered skills, showing each Agent's skill, status and elapsed time. A badge counts running calls. State stays in host memory; no API key is needed.
我想在网页侧栏看清每个 Agent 正在调用哪个技能以及已经运行多久。
DSH 里手动触发的技能和模型调用的技能能不能都显示完成或失败状态？
Can I see live skill activity and elapsed time for each agent in the web sidebar?
Skill Invocation Monitor 的功能「双路径技能追踪」：同时记录模型发起的 skill 工具调用和用户触发的技能消息，并归并到对应 Agent。
Skill Invocation Monitor 的功能「侧栏实时状态面板」：打开 Web 侧栏面板查看调用状态、技能名和时长，侧栏入口徽标显示运行中数量。

text:
@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| Live Agent list | Every live Agent, its session title, and whether it is running or idle |
| Per-call rows | Skill name, status (`运行中` / `已完成` / `失败` / `未观测到结果`), elapsed time, start clock |
| Both invocation paths | The model's `skill` tool call, and a human triggering a skill — marked `用户触发` |
| Ticking durations | The elapsed time updates every second while a call is running |
| Sidebar badge | The running-call count sits on the sidebar entry, so you can see activity without opening the panel |
| Honest failures | A failed call shows a truncated reason, e.g. `skill "…" is unknown or no longer available` |
| Self-check diagnostics | Every response carries counters describing what the plugin observed, so a wrong assumption is visible rather than silent |
| Zero dependencies | Neither half imports a third-party package (the browser half uses only `react` from the host module table) |
@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · Permissions and data：This plugin exists to observe, and its whole design is built around not participating.

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · Permissions and data：| | |
|---|---|
| Observes (read-only) | Five Cordis events: `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/result`, `session/event`, `agent/status`, `agent/disposed` |
| Reads | The live Agent list, session titles, and the durable session-event feed as it is appended |
| Does **not** write | No session state, no session log, nothing on disk, no config, no tool, no command |
| Does **not** interfere | The `tools/pre-execute` listener returns `next()` unchanged and never denies, cancels, rewrites or delays a call; every observer is wrapped so a bug in this plugin cannot break a dispatch |
| HTTP surface | Exactly one route, `GET /api/plugins/skill-monitor/state` — no body, no mutation, `cache-control: no-store` |
| Network exposure | Loopback only: a non-loopback peer, a cross-site fetch marker or a foreign `Origin` gets `403`; any non-GET method gets `405` |
| Where the data lives | One `Map` in host memory. Records are capped (200 by default) and expire (10 minutes after they settle); restarting DSH clears everything |
| Not collected | Prompt text, model output, file contents, credentials, or anything else the plugin never reads |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · Compatibility：| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | Verified against **0.2.0-rc.2** (the build this plugin was developed and tested on). The seams it uses are documented core surfaces, so other 0.2.x builds are expected to work |
| Node.js | Declared `>=20`. The plugin runs inside the DSH host, so the host's own Node requirement is what matters |
| Surface | Web GUI (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`). Uses only official Slots — `sidebar.panellist` for the entry and `main` for the panel — never DOM injection |
| Skill paths | Uses the durable contracts for both paths: tool calls on `tools/pre-execute` / `tools/result`, and human invocations through the `skill-invocation` message source declared by the skills seam |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：| | Model path | User path |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger | The model calls the `skill` tool | You invoke a skill (e.g. `/grill-me`) |
| What DSH does | Runs the tool pipeline and produces a tool result | Appends the skill's instructions to the conversation as a `user/message` — **no tool call and no command event** |
| Pairing key | `callId` | the message `id` |
| Duration measured | `tools/result` − `pre-execute` | `turn/end` − injection (see the note below) |
| Row marker | none | `用户触发` |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：The name comes straight from `source.name`, so no skill-catalog lookup and no text parsing is involved. That
is a measured result, not a guess: an earlier implementation assumed the human path went through
`command/run` / `command/done`, and a real session log disproved it — a human-invoked skill produces no
command event at all, which removed an entire catalog cache and its 60-second TTL.

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：**One deliberate choice:** a human skill has no result event of its own, so its duration is the *turn window* (injection until `turn/end`), not the skill's own execution time. That is a stated convention, not a measurement — if you would rather see an instantaneous event with a duration of 0, only the settling point changes.
Status semantics

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `运行中` | A start was observed (a pre-execute or a skill message) and no ending event has arrived; the duration grows live |
| `已完成` | The tool reported `isError === false`, or the turn that carried the skill ended normally |
| `失败` | The tool reported `isError === true`; the row shows a truncated reason |
| `未观测到结果` | No ending event arrived within 15 minutes (the call was denied before dispatch, its parent was cancelled, the host crashed). This is a *derived* status and is never written back into the record |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：
The read-only contract This is the plugin's core constraint, and there are tests asserting each row.

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：| Constraint | How it is implemented |
|---|---|
| Registers no writable tool | Never touches `ctx.tools` — no `register`, `restrict` or `guard`; `apply()` adds no member to `ctx` (asserted by a test) |
| Modifies no session state | Never appends a session event, never writes a session log, never calls a service method; only reads `agents.list()` / `sessions.get()` / `sessionTitle.get()` |
| Intercepts nothing | The `tools/pre-execute` listener returns `next()` untouched and never denies, cancels, rewrites or measures; a hostile arguments Proxy cannot make it block a call (asserted by a test) |
| Writes nothing to disk | All state is one in-memory `Map`, capped and expiring; no history, no persistence, no alerting |
| One read-only route | `GET /api/plugins/skill-monitor/state` only — no POST, no request body, no write path |
| Zero runtime dependencies | Neither half imports a third-party package |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：
Diagnostics — how a wrong assumption stays visible instead of silent Every state response carries a `diagnostics` object describing what the plugin actually saw:

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：| Field | What it tells you |
|---|---|
| `sessionEvents` | The durable event feed did reach the plugin |
| `skillInjections` / `trackedInjections` | Human skill messages were seen and recorded |
| `unmatchedInjections` | A `skill-invocation` message arrived whose name could not be read |
| `turnEnds` / `settledByTurnEnd` | Turn endings arrived, and how many human records they closed |

This is not decoration: it is what caught the disproved command-path assumption in the first place.

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · How it works：
Configuration (optional) ```yaml - id: skill-invocation-monitor name: '@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor' config: maxRecords: 200 # in-memory record cap

text:
@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 功能：| | |
|---|---|
| 实时 Agent 列表 | 每个活动 Agent、它的会话标题，以及它是运行中还是空闲 |
| 每次调用一行 | Skill 名、状态（`运行中` / `已完成` / `失败` / `未观测到结果`）、时长、起始时刻 |
| 两条调用路径 | 模型的 `skill` 工具调用，以及人手动触发的技能——后者标 `用户触发` |
| 时长实时跳动 | 运行中的调用每秒刷新一次时长 |
| 侧边栏徽标 | 运行中计数直接挂在侧边栏入口上，不打开面板也能看出有没有活动 |
| 如实呈现失败 | 失败的调用附带截断后的原因，例如 `skill "…" is unknown or no longer available` |
| 自检诊断 | 每次响应都带一组计数，描述插件实际看到了什么，让错误假设**可见而不是静默** |
| 零依赖 | 两个半都不 import 任何第三方包（浏览器半只用宿主模块表里的 `react`） |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 权限与数据：| | |
|---|---|
| 观察（只读） | 五个 Cordis 事件：`tools/pre-execute`、`tools/result`、`session/event`、`agent/status`、`agent/disposed` |
| 读取 | 活动 Agent 列表、会话标题、以及边落盘边推送的会话事件流 |
| **不**写入 | 不写会话状态、不写 session log、不落盘、不写配置、不注册工具、不注册命令 |
| **不**干预 | `tools/pre-execute` 监听器原样返回 `next()`，从不拒绝/取消/改写/延缓任何调用；每个观察器都整体包裹，插件自身的 bug 无法破坏工具派发 |
| HTTP 面 | 只有一条路由 `GET /api/plugins/skill-monitor/state`——无请求体、无写操作、`cache-control: no-store` |
| 网络暴露 | 仅回环：非回环来源、跨站标记或外部 `Origin` 一律 `403`；非 GET 方法一律 `405` |
| 数据在哪 | 宿主内存里的一个 `Map`。记录有上限（默认 200）并按时间淘汰（结算后 10 分钟）；重启 DSH 即清空 |
| 不收集 | 提示词正文、模型输出、文件内容、凭据，以及任何插件根本没有读的东西 |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 兼容性：| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | 在 **0.2.0-rc.2** 上验证通过（本插件的开发与测试环境）。所用接缝均为官方核心面，预期其他 0.2.x 构建同样可用 |
| Node.js | 声明 `>=20`。插件运行在 DSH 宿主内，实际以宿主自身的 Node 要求为准 |
| 界面 | Web GUI（`dsh.client.platform: "web"`）。只用官方 Slot——入口用 `sidebar.panellist`，面板用 `main`——不做任何 DOM 注入 |
| 技能路径 | 两条路径都走持久化契约：工具调用走 `tools/pre-execute` / `tools/result`；人的调用走技能接缝声明的 `skill-invocation` 消息来源 |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：
两条调用路径——以及为什么人这条是读消息来源 技能在 DSH 里有两种结构性完全不同的到达方式，插件两条都观察。 | | 模型路径 | 用户路径 | |---|---|---| | 触发 | 模型调用 `skill` 工具 | 你在会话里调用一个技能（例如 `/grill-me`） | | DSH 的行为 | 走工具流水线并产生工具结果 | 把技能正文作为一条 `user/message` 追加进对话——**既不产生工具调用，也不产生命令事件** | | 配对键 | `callId` | 该消息的 `id` | | 时长口径 | `tools/result` − `pre-execute` | `turn/end` − 注入时刻（见下） | | 行内标记 | 无 | `用户触发` | 人这条路径读的是技能接缝自己附上的结构化来源（持久化目录里的 `SkillInvocationSource`）：

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：```json
{ "type": "user/message", "data": {
    "source": { "kind": "skill-invocation", "name": "grill-me", "form": "instructions" },
    "role": "user", "id": "7c2e0f5a-3b9d-4e18-9a6c-1d2f3a4b5c6d" } }
```

名字直接来自 `source.name`，既不需要查技能目录，也不需要解析正文。这是**量出来的**而不是猜的：早先的
实现假设人这条路径走 `command/run` / `command/done`，一份真实会话日志否掉了它——人手动调用的技能
**完全不产生命令事件**，于是那套目录缓存与它的 60 秒 TTL 一并删除。

**一个刻意的口径选择**：人类技能没有自己的结果事件，所以它的时长是**该轮次的窗口**（注入 → `turn/end`），
而不是技能自身的执行耗时。这是声明出来的约定，不是测量值——若你更想看到"瞬时事件、时长为 0"，
要改的只是结算点。

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：
状态语义 | 状态 | 含义 | |---|---| | `运行中` | 已观察到开始（pre-execute 或技能消息），结束事件还没到；时长实时增长 | | `已完成` | 工具报告 `isError === false`，或承载该技能的那一轮正常结束 | | `失败` | 工具报告 `isError === true`；该行附带截断后的原因 | | `未观测到结果` | 15 分钟内没有任何结束事件（调用在派发前被拒、父调用被取消、宿主崩溃）。这是**推导**状态，从不写回记录 |
只读契约 这是本插件的核心约束，每一行都有测试断言。

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：| 约束 | 实现方式 |
|---|---|
| 不注册可写工具 | 从不触碰 `ctx.tools`——无 `register` / `restrict` / `guard`；`apply()` 不向 `ctx` 添加任何成员（有测试断言） |
| 不修改会话状态 | 从不 append 会话事件、从不写 session log、从不调用任何服务方法；只读 `agents.list()` / `sessions.get()` / `sessionTitle.get()` |
| 不拦截任何调用 | `tools/pre-execute` 监听器原样返回 `next()`，从不拒绝/取消/改写/计时；用恶意 Proxy 实参也无法让它阻断调用（有测试断言） |
| 不落盘 | 全部状态是内存里一个 `Map`，有上限、会淘汰；无历史、无持久化、无告警 |
| 单一只读路由 | 只有 `GET /api/plugins/skill-monitor/state`——无 POST、无请求体、无写路径 |
| 零运行时依赖 | 两个半都不 import 任何第三方包 |

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：
自检诊断——让错误假设可见而不是静默 每次状态响应都带一个 `diagnostics` 对象，描述插件实际看到了什么： | 字段 | 它告诉你什么 | |---|---| | `sessionEvents` | 落盘事件流确实到达了插件 | | `skillInjections` / `trackedInjections` | 技能消息被看见并被记录 | | `unmatchedInjections` | 收到了一条 `skill-invocation` 消息，但名字读不出来 | | `turnEnds` / `settledByTurnEnd` | 轮次结束事件到达了，以及它结算掉了多少条人类记录 | 这不是装饰：最早那条被证伪的"命令路径"假设，正是被它抓出来的。
配置（可选）

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 工作原理：```yaml
- id: skill-invocation-monitor
  name: '@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor'
  config:
    maxRecords: 200          # 内存中保留的调用记录上限

</details>

@yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor README · 开发：<details>
<summary>测试、脚本与仓库结构（面向贡献者）</summary>
